parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications defaults to required; Preferred Qualifications makes its items nice_to_have.
Generic AI tools is provisionally mapped to ai-ml, not AI coding tools; the posting does not specify coding assistance.
Intelligent automation solutions is provisionally mapped to workflow-automation in the testing-workflow context.
Productivity tool development has no direct taxonomy entry. Its alternative, test automation, maps to testing, which is also independently required by web and mobile tests; consequently this alternative does not form a scored group.
Testing and agents are independently requested outside the preferred list of AI testing frameworks, autonomous testing agents or intelligent automation solutions, so that list produces no additional alternative group.
CI/CD and LLMs appear only in responsibilities and are excluded. Business logic knowledge and soft skills are excluded.
